text: Project IntroductionThis major is taught in English, aiming to cultivate applied, compound, innovative and entrepreneurial management talents who can systematically master modern economic management theories and methods, possess an international perspective, innovative consciousness, teamwork spirit and communication skills, and be capable of engaging in economic management work.The basic duration of study for this major is 4 years, with a flexible system ranging from 4 to 6 years. Students who meet the graduation requirements will be awarded a Bachelor of Management degree.
